_note: v2.8 plan 60 B3 (no-model lane): an install-wide setting written through our settings store leaves in its own save request within a few hundred ms (well inside ST's 1 s debounce) and survives a page reload made right after. The setting is put back the same way and read back after a second reload. Run: node scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/v28-60-b3-settings-reload.json --sandbox --group 'Group: Arin, DM Narrator', twice.

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const was = rt.getGlobalSettings().stagecraft.meanwhileAcceptMode; const next = was === 'review' ? 'auto' : 'review'; const posts = []; const original = globalThis.fetch; globalThis.fetch = async (input, init) => { const url = String(typeof input === 'string' ? input : input?.url ?? ''); if (url.includes('/api/settings/save')) { const row = { sentMs: Date.now() - t0, status: null, doneMs: null }; posts.push(row); const response = await original(input, init); row.status = response.status; row.doneMs = Date.now() - t0; return response; } return original(input, init); }; const t0 = Date.now(); try { rt.setStagecraftSettings({ meanwhileAcceptMode: next }); for (let i = 0; i < 40 && !posts.some((p) => p.status === 200); i += 1) await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 25)); } finally { globalThis.fetch = original; } const saved = posts.find((p) => p.status === 200); if (!saved) throw new Error('no settings save completed within 1 s of the write: ' + JSON.stringify(posts)); if (saved.sentMs >= 500) throw new Error('the save left ' + saved.sentMs + ' ms after the write (debounce, not immediate)'); globalThis.__b3 = { was, next }; sessionStorage.setItem('__b3', JSON.stringify({ was, next })); return { was, next, save: saved };

const { was, next } = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('__b3') ?? 'null') ?? {}; if (!next) throw new Error('lost the fixture marker across the reload'); const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const now = rt.getGlobalSettings().stagecraft.meanwhileAcceptMode; if (now !== next) throw new Error('the setting did not survive the immediate reload: ' + now + ' (wanted ' + next + ')'); const posts = []; const original = globalThis.fetch; globalThis.fetch = async (input, init) => { const url = String(typeof input === 'string' ? input : input?.url ?? ''); if (url.includes('/api/settings/save')) { const response = await original(input, init); posts.push(response.status); return response; } return original(input, init); }; try { rt.setStagecraftSettings({ meanwhileAcceptMode: was }); for (let i = 0; i < 40 && !posts.includes(200); i += 1) await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 25)); } finally { globalThis.fetch = original; } if (!posts.includes(200)) throw new Error('the restoring save did not complete'); return { survived: now, restoring: was };

const { was } = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('__b3') ?? 'null') ?? {}; sessionStorage.removeItem('__b3'); const now = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getGlobalSettings().stagecraft.meanwhileAcceptMode; if (now !== was) throw new Error('the restored setting did not survive the reload: ' + now); return { restored: now };
